import json

import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
import matplotlib.dates as mdates
from datetime import datetime
import numpy as np

# Load data
with open('/app/benchmark/source_data.json', 'r') as f:
    data = json.load(f)

with open('/app/benchmark/task_input.json', 'r') as f:
    task = json.load(f)

# Parse dates
def parse_date(date_str):
    return datetime.strptime(date_str, '%Y-%m')

# Prepare milestone data
tracks = [
    {'name': 'Research', 'data': data['research_milestones']['data'], 'color': '#2563eb', 'y': 2},
    {'name': 'Industry', 'data': data['industry_milestones']['data'], 'color': '#16a34a', 'y': 1},
    {'name': 'Regulation', 'data': data['regulation_milestones']['data'], 'color': '#dc2626', 'y': 0}
]

# Significance markers
significance_config = {
    'medium': {'size': 80, 'alpha': 0.7},
    'high': {'size': 120, 'alpha': 0.85},
    'critical': {'size': 180, 'alpha': 1.0}
}

# Investment data
investment = data['ai_investment']['data']
inv_years = [datetime(y, 7, 1) for y in [d['year'] for d in investment]]
inv_values = [d['investment'] for d in investment]

# Create figure
fig, ax1 = plt.subplots(figsize=(18, 9))

# Set up x-axis for dates
ax1.set_xlim(datetime(2010, 1, 1), datetime(2026, 1, 1))
ax1.xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.YearLocator())
ax1.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter('%Y'))

# Plot investment as area chart
ax2 = ax1.twinx()
ax2.fill_between(inv_years, inv_values, alpha=0.15, color='#9333ea', label='AI Investment')
ax2.plot(inv_years, inv_values, color='#9333ea', linewidth=2.5, marker='o', markersize=4, label='AI Investment ($B)')
ax2.set_ylabel('Investment (Billion USD)', fontsize=11, color='#9333ea')
ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#9333ea')
ax2.set_ylim(0, 150)

# Plot milestones on each track
for track in tracks:
    y = track['y']
    color = track['color']

    for event in track['data']:
        date = parse_date(event['date'])
        sig = event['significance']
        cfg = significance_config[sig]

        # Plot marker
        ax1.scatter(date, y, s=cfg['size'], c=color, alpha=cfg['alpha'],
                   edgecolors='white', linewidths=1, zorder=3)

# Add track labels on y-axis
ax1.set_yticks([0, 1, 2])
ax1.set_yticklabels(['Regulation', 'Industry', 'Research'], fontsize=12)

# Mark key inflection points

ax1.axvline(x=chatgpt_date, color='#f59e0b', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, alpha=0.8, zorder=1)
ax1.text(chatgpt_date, 2.35, 'ChatGPT\n(Nov 2022)', ha='center', fontsize=9, color='#f59e0b', fontweight='bold')

# Transformer annotation for lag pattern

ax1.annotate('Transformer\n(2017)', xy=(transformer_date, 2), xytext=(transformer_date, 2.25),
            ha='center', fontsize=8, color='#2563eb')

# EU AI Act annotation

ax1.annotate('EU AI Act\n(2024)', xy=(eu_act_date, 0), xytext=(eu_act_date, 0.35),
            ha='center', fontsize=8, color='#dc2626')

# Title and labels
ax1.set_title('The AI Revolution: Research, Industry & Regulation (2010-2025)', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', pad=20)
ax1.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=12)

# Grid
ax1.grid(True, axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='-', linewidth=0.5)
ax1.set_axisbelow(True)

# Legend
legend_elements = [
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#2563eb', markersize=12, label='Research'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#16a34a', markersize=12, label='Industry'),
    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color='w', markerfacecolor='#dc2626', markersize=12, label='Regulation'),
    Line2D([0], [0], color='#9333ea', linewidth=2.5, marker='o', markersize=5, label='AI Investment ($B)'),
    Line2D([0], [0], color='#f59e0b', linewidth=2, linestyle='--', label='ChatGPT Inflection'),
    mpatches.Patch(alpha=0.3, label='Marker size = significance')
]
ax1.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='upper left', fontsize=9, ncol=2)

# Add insight annotation
insight_text = "Key Pattern: Research → Industry (2-4yr) → Regulation (3-5yr)\nChatGPT (2022) compressed this lag to months"
ax1.text(0.98, 0.02, insight_text, transform=ax1.transAxes, fontsize=9,
        ha='right', va='bottom', style='italic',
        bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.5))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
print("Chart saved to /app/output/result.png")
